items.title: France braces for another weekend of protests as authorities launch massive security operation
items.brief: France is bracing for yet another wave of protests this weekend with authorities racing to prevent a repeat of the kind of violence and riots that hit the nation last week.

items.title: Melania Trump secures one-city ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine for humanitarian aid
items.brief: First lady Melania Trump announced on Friday that she helped secure a localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the city of Oleshky to facilitate the humane evacuation of elderly residents.

items.title: One killed, four injured in drive-by shooting near Paris
items.brief: A gunman opened fire from a car outside Paris, killing one person and wounding four others including a 12-year-old girl on Friday, French authorities said.

items.title: At least 7 people killed in unprecedented shooting at church in Jordan
items.brief: At least seven people were killed, and 27 injured, after gunmen opened fire on a church in Jordan’s southern Karak province in an unprecedented attack that has left the nation stunned.

items.title: Top Trump political advisers donate fee for work on behalf of pro-Russian government after he floated firing them
items.brief: Top Trump political advisers James Blair and Chris LaCivita have donated money they made earlier this month in the Balkans on behalf of a pro-Russian government to President Donald Trump’s presidential library.
